logp.method_description: We first conducted a simple evaluation of the lipophilic-hydrophilic partition coefficient (log P) and cell uptake capacity. Through the application of the shake-flask method and UV-visible spectrophotometry, Log P values of 8a,b (0.98 and -1.43) in Table S3 were investigated by the octanol-water dispersing system.
